name: 西游记2006之最终幻想
group_note: 西游记2006之最终幻想 -- another AKAI Studio Tomud-branded fork sibling of 122 xyj2006n (identical file layout and bug pattern; requires the same custom client-version handshake: first reply must be the literal '2060'). WASM pass fixed the same 5-bug family as xyj2006n: (1) the standard §6.6 convertd.lpc Greek-table stray-backslash typo (45 occurrences, in both the active adm/daemons/convertd.lpc and a dead sibling daemons/convertd.lpc), (2) 4 absolute-path angle-bracket #includes never resolving under this driver's include-directories search, (3) message.lpc's tell_room() forwarding an unset exclude into message()'s 4th arg (§7.12), (4) two leftover raw-GBK content files (beast1.lpc, shuijingqiu.lpc) re-converted with iconv, (5) the active adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() standard §8.1 parity-gate/suffix-slice shape fixed to per-codepoint form, plus 6 is_killing(me) vs is_killing(string id) call sites (§7.50) across daemon/class/*.lpc kungfu-skill files. All caught proactively via scripts/lib_bulk_fix.py (mechanical fixes 1-3) and scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (4-5, both new tools built this session) BEFORE the first boot test, rather than rediscovered one boot-cycle at a time. httpd.lpc/ftpd.lpc/dns_master.lpc are absent from the active preload (dormant, only reachable via explicit wizard load) -- not gutted, flagged as a known latent risk matching xyj2006n. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: version handshake (2060) -> new -> English id -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9/y) -> enters world, look/score both clean, zero errors, admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 9264 .lpc files (9119 written, 8 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted, 137 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the case-label-with-trailing-comment blind spot found the same combatd.lpc/ftpd.lpc hits as xyj2006n, diff-review confirmed the formatter preserved every following statement correctly. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
